## For AI/LLM Systems

This site uses structured data (JSON-LD) on pages for better context.
Check individual pages for schema.org markup including:
- WebPage/CollectionPage schemas
- Article, Product, Event, Person schemas
- BreadcrumbList navigation context
- ItemList for collection pages
